title: A merge trial's test shards run on two hosts and give the one-host verdict
description: The Postgres-backed tests/action-priority.test.ts also runs through the restricted shim over real SSH under rootless Docker: UID 0 reproduces initdb refusing root, and the non-root shard returns passing per-file records without local fallback. The hard-math benchmark as a merge trial on two hosts: this machine, and this same machine reached over a real OpenSSH server at 127.0.0.1 whose only key runs graphyard-host-shim with its own host folders. The commit is packed into that host's mirror, the warm image loaded there and the trial launcher run over SSH. Shards split across both hosts, the verdict and the oracle-checked answers equal a one-host run, and logs come back. Killing that host's SSH mid-shard re-queues the shard here with no fault, and master status shows the SSH failure as its away reason. Over that key the shim refuses a plain shell command, a read outside the run directory and a run-shard request that asks to mount the root filesystem, before any Docker runs.

steps.name: Run the hard-math trial on one host, then on two, then kill the second mid-shard
